create_model_unet: create a 3D sparse convolutional UNet model for semantic segmentation with configurable feature planes
build_training_loop: build a training loop that iterates epochs, computes loss, stores predictions, and updates model weights
compute_iou_metrics: compute intersection-over-union metrics across categories and CAD model parts for segmentation evaluation
store_batch_predictions: store batch predictions and ground truth labels aggregated by category and file for metric computation
run_validation_epoch: run a validation epoch at specified checkpoints with repeated passes and IoU reporting
